sourceKind: Turnpo Stock PDC engine daily watchlists + backfills

primary.label: Stock PDC 本地日度数据集
primary.policy: Hawkeye、PDC、决策模型和复盘只读取这个冻结数据集。

backup.label: 未配置备用校验源
backup.policy: 备用源仅用于缺失或异常校验，不得混入正式评分或模型事实包。

strategy.rankingStage: PDC scores rank radar-selected candidates for internal research only
strategy.decisionRule: Show only BUY from approved purchase instructions and HOLD/SELL from confirmed OPEN positions.
strategy.exitRule: A dropped research row is not a sell action; confirmed OPEN positions retain the HOLD_DROPPED_UP_DAY override.
strategy.researchRetention: All factor scores, reasons, and risks are retained for later attribution and tuning.

rows.name: 国电电力

rules.buy: Only PDC-approved rows from daily_purchase_instruction.csv; never pad the list.
rules.hold: Only confirmed OPEN positions with a hold instruction, including HOLD_DROPPED_UP_DAY.
rules.sell: Only confirmed OPEN positions with a sell instruction; manual review only.
rules.hidden: Watchlists, candidates, rankings, PLANNED_OPEN rows, and non-actionable research statuses are hidden.

summary.decisionRule: Ranked rows are research-only; user actions come from the approved purchase list and confirmed OPEN positions.
